svg.text: BellmanLab | a small residual is not a small value error
One-state supplied MDP: reward 1/100, discount 99/100, initial value 0. Exact value = 1.
Same linear scale, shared zero. The raw residual misses the value-error tolerance of 1/10.
Certificate: ||v - v*|| infinity <= residual / (1 - discount). Exact fractions, no stopping tolerance in equality.
230 synchronous sweeps bring the certified value error below 1/10; every backup and audit is returned.
Separate delayed-return fixture: immediate policy value 1; exact policy iteration reaches 9/5 at the start state.
Complete supplied discounted model, not online RL, learned transitions or a statistical confidence bound.
Exact initial/final certificates and selected checkpoints in SVG metadata; full histories remain in CLI demo.
